> **Rollback plan — `<service>` v`<new-version>`**

> **Verify rollback succeeded:** health check green, error rate < 0.5% for 5 minutes, data-integrity check passes.
>
> **Owner:** `<on-call engineer>` decides and executes; notifies `#deployments` and files a postmortem within 24h.

| "Database is handled" | Tested backup + reversible migrations *before* deploying |
